name: orchestrator-ai
description: A project-neutral VS Code coordinator with managed AI Memory continuity and native agent orchestration.

commands.title: Orchestrator: Install or Start AI Memory Runtime
Orchestrator: Check AI Memory Runtime and Optional Lich Adapter
Orchestrator: Open Configured Agent in New Chat Session

languageModelTools.name: orchestrator-ai_initialize_workspace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create the generic .ai/specs and .ai/skills structure and add the extension's reusable workflow skills without overwriting existing project files.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Add the orchestrator's generic project guidance.

languageModelTools.name: orchestrator-ai_install_dependencies
languageModelTools.displayName: Install or start AI Memory runtime
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Install and start the exact stable AI Memory release pinned in this extension build under Orchestrator storage. The optional Lich compatibility adapter is not installed or started.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Install or start Orchestrator's managed AI Memory runtime.

languageModelTools.name: orchestrator-ai_check_tools
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Check the managed AI Memory runtime and report whether an optional Lich compatibility adapter is available. This is read-only.

languageModelTools.name: orchestrator-ai_list_lich_sessions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List live lich coding-agent sessions for this workspace. Read-only.

languageModelTools.name: orchestrator-ai_delegate_lich_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a specialist agent session in lich for this project, optionally in an isolated worktree. Use for a bounded independent task and report the created session. This changes local agent state and requires user confirmation.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Start a bounded task in a lich agent session.

task.description: A bounded task with a concrete expected result.

provider.description: Optional Lich provider override; it must be enabled in the Orchestrator's allowed worker providers. Defaults to the configured Lich worker provider when allowed.

model.description: Optional model override; defaults to the configured lich model.

effort.description: Optional reasoning effort override; defaults to the configured lich effort.

worktree.description: Optional new worktree branch name. Use the literal 'current' only when the task must operate on the currently open checkout (including uncommitted files); this shares the project's local changes. Leave empty to create an isolated worktree.

languageModelTools.name: orchestrator-ai_stop_lich_task
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Stop an active Lich session and park it while preserving its project checkout and changes. The user must confirm.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Stop and preserve an active agent task.

session.description: Lich session id, name, or label.

languageModelTools.name: orchestrator-ai_continue_lich_task
languageModelTools.displayName: Continue a task with an agent
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Continue work from a Lich session, either in the same Claude conversation with a new model/effort or by stopping and parking the old session then starting another supported Lich provider in the same checkout. Include a concise handoff when changing providers. The user must confirm.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Stop or switch agents and continue a task with a handoff.

session.description: Existing Lich session id, name, or label.

task.description: The next bounded task to perform.

provider.description: Optional destination CLI provider supported by Lich, for example claude or codex.

model.description: Optional model override for the next task.

effort.description: Optional effort override for the next task.

handoff.description: Short status, findings, files changed, and remaining steps from the previous agent.

languageModelTools.name: orchestrator-ai_sync_upstreams
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Fast-forward only the upstream repositories listed in .ai/orchestrator.json. Refuses dirty repositories and never resets or force-updates. This changes local repositories and requires user confirmation.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Update declared upstream repositories before a build.

languageModelTools.name: orchestrator-ai_run_build
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Synchronize configured upstream repositories first, then run the build command declared in .ai/orchestrator.json. Refuses to run when the project has no configured build command. This runs project code and requires user confirmation.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Sync declared upstreams and run the configured build.
